label: conducted massive drone attack on Moscow region
detail: Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelensky confirmed Kyiv hit a key Russian oil facility and logistics site in the Moscow region. Russian officials reported at least two people killed and six injured, with 450 drones intercepted according to Moscow Mayor Sergei Sobyanin.
source_title: Two killed in 'massive' Ukrainian drone attack on Moscow region, says Russia

label: banned three news outlets from White House access
detail: Donald Trump banned CNN, MS NOW, and Politico from White House access, denying journalists from these organizations credential access. The organizations stated the move violates First Amendment protections and restricts access based on coverage.
source_title: Journalists locked out of the White House after Trump ban

label: sought support from tech companies for internet safety and AI regulation
detail: Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese met with Apple's executive chairman Tim Cook at Apple headquarters in Cupertino, California on September 20, 2026, to discuss strengthening Australia's online safety laws and AI regulations. Albanese stated that Australia cannot address these issues alone and called for stronger AI regulation, announcing that Australia will introduce new AI standards by the end of the year.
source_title: Australia seeks big tech support for internet safety, AI regulation

label: rolled out Ebola vaccine for health workers with WHO backing
detail: The Democratic Republic of the Congo began vaccinating health workers with the Ervebo vaccine starting September 19, 2026, in Bunia, Ituri province, backed by the World Health Organization and Doctors Without Borders. The operation targets approximately 50,000 health and frontline workers across Ituri and North Kivu provinces during an ongoing Ebola outbreak.
source_title: DR Congo rolls out Ebola vaccine for health workers as death toll rises

label: launched massive drone attack on Moscow during Russian parliamentary elections
detail: Ukraine fired over 1,000 drones at Russia, including hundreds targeting Moscow, in what Moscow's mayor described as the largest ever attack on the Russian capital. The attack killed at least two people and damaged a major oil refinery on the final day of Russia's parliamentary elections.
source_title: Live: Russian election enters final day in shadow of war in Ukraine
